### 🟢 Approval recommended It is a mechanical, well-tested single-constant deduplication whose widened `readonly string[]` types are used read-only by all verified consumers, with dist artifacts consistent with source and no behavioral change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR deduplicates the default quiet-hours bypass set (`permission`, `activity_error`), which was previously a hand-maintained literal in three places (server, mobile app, dashboard) with nothing keeping them in sync. It introduces a per-category `defaultBypass` flag on the `@chroxy/protocol` notification-category roster and derives a single `DEFAULT_BYPASS_CATEGORIES` export from it, following the existing derived-export pattern (`NOTIFICATION_CATEGORY_ORDER`, `_LABELS`). The server keeps its own runtime copy (to avoid depending on the UI/Zod graph), now pinned to the protocol flag in both directions by the roster test. **Changes:** - Add an optional `defaultBypass` flag to `NotificationCategoryMeta` and a derived `DEFAULT_BYPASS_CATEGORIES` export in `@chroxy/protocol` (plus rebuilt dist artifacts). - Replace the local bypass literals in the app (`constants.ts`) and dashboard (`SettingsPanel.tsx`) with the protocol export, widening `QuietHoursEditor`'s `bypassCategories` prop to `readonly string[]`. - Add roster/app tests that pin the server's and clients' bypass sets to the protocol flag in both directions. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `packages/​protocol/​src/​notification-categories.ts` | Adds `defaultBypass` flag + derived `DEFAULT_BYPASS_CATEGORIES` export and explanatory docs. | | `packages/​protocol/​dist/​notification-categories.js` | Rebuilt JS artifact matching the new source. | | `packages/​protocol/​dist/​notification-categories.d.ts` | Rebuilt type declarations for the new flag/export. | | `packages/​server/​src/​notification-prefs.js` | Comment-only update documenting the protocol pinning; runtime literal unchanged. | | `packages/​server/​tests/​notification-category-roster.test.js` | New bidirectional tests pinning server vs. protocol bypass sets. | | `packages/​dashboard/​src/​components/​SettingsPanel.tsx` | Removes local literal, imports protocol export, widens prop to `readonly string[]`. | | `packages/​app/​src/​components/​settings/​constants.ts` | Re-exports the protocol bypass set instead of a local literal. | | `packages/​app/​src/​components/​settings/​QuietHoursEditor.tsx` | Widens `bypassCategories` prop to `readonly string[]`. | | `packages/​app/​src/​__tests__/​components/​SettingsScreenNotificationPrefs.test.ts` | Asserts the constant is the protocol set with no local literal. |
Review effort: Balanced
